risk_note: RV2 by path (payment). Admin original-route refund (BR-PAY-06, BR-PAY-07; no step-up per the owner 2026-10-05): POST /admin/v1/pay-orders/{id}/refunds and /admin/v1/pay-anomalies/{id}/refunds (pay.refund) write the idempotency record (subject a:<admin_user_id>), the refund row (out_refund_no generated once), the amount hold under the business-object lock (succeeded + processing + this <= refundable), the delayed refund.query job and the audit row in one transaction, and call the channel only after commit (ok / unknown / error never change the refund). Refund notifications and refund.query share one result handler (identity, refund number, original, channel, amount, state lists in that order; a mismatch keeps PROCESSING and alerts); SUCCESS in one transaction: CAS, refunded_fen, PAY_REFUND (or a reverse PAY_ANOMALY for an anomaly), biz.reconcile for pay orders, event pay_refund.succeeded. Unknown results are only queried, never resubmitted. Migration 0088 (D10-350 / D10-351 ②): pay_refunds.note (nullable, length checked by the application) and pay_refunds_idempotency_key_key rebuilt under the same name as UNIQUE (app_id, operator, idempotency_key), pinned in APPROVED_GUARD_CHANGES by #1591 (D10-352). The two refund operations leave planned; the frozen CT-21e contract tests were split by #1585 and only the refund blocks tightened (red_exempt for the 23 unchanged tests, #1589). Taken over by admin-backend from the pay lane.

After the review only the migration number (0098 -> 0088) and two comment lines changed.
